summary: Backend-only testing of Report-a-Bug (iter 264). Added 21 pytest cases covering create+validation (customer/partner), /bugs/my ownership + newest-first + app_label, DELETE rules (blocked while open, 403 cross-user, 404 missing, succeeds after solved and blocked again after reopen), admin list filters/pagination/counts, admin resolve with note (and empty-note default) incl. reporter visibility + db.notifications row for the reporter, admin reopen, and auth guards (401 w/o token, 403 wrong role). All 21 tests pass when run serially. Cleanup via module fixture removes TEST_* bug_reports rows.

minor.issue: Project's default pytest config enables pytest-xdist parallel workers; each worker re-logs in and invalidates prior single-device sessions, causing 401s and KeyError('id') failures across tests. Mitigation: run this file with `-o addopts=""` or `-p no:xdist` to force serial. The file is tagged with xdist_group so loadscope distribution keeps it on a single worker.

critical_code_review_comments: controllers/bug_controller.py admin_list treats status='closed' as a valid filter but reporters can't produce 'closed' rows via the public API; harmless but undocumented in the request. Counts.solved correctly groups solved+closed.
admin_resolve stores resolved_by as admin.name (falls back to 'Admin'); no admin.id tracked. Consider also storing resolved_by_id for audit.
No max-length validation at the pydantic layer for title/description; controller truncates to 160/4000. Acceptable but could 422 earlier.
my_bugs returns up to 500 rows (no pagination); fine for current volume.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_* bug_reports documents created during the run; module-scoped fixture deletes them from db.bug_reports by id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 python -m pytest backend/tests/test_bug_reports_iter264.py -v -o addopts=""`. Backend is at localhost:8001, routes under /api. Bug collection = db.bug_reports; reporter notifications are stored in db.notifications with data.bug_id. Only reporter can delete their own bug and only when status in (solved, closed). admin_resolve emits SSE bug_update + notification; admin_reopen flips to open and does not clear notifications.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found; all specified acceptance criteria behave correctly.
